scientific_scope: PEt3 催化环戊烯酮形成、相关分支竞争、活化瓶颈和配平净热力学。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 所提完整形成路线的关键相连态 Gibbs 能量、各关键转化局部活化量及统一参照下的活化需求。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed key-state Gibbs energies, local activation energies and common-reference activation requirements along the proposed connected product-formation route.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 相关实质竞争分支的可比活化量和差值。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed comparable activation energies and differences for the substantive competing branches.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 按公开缔合起点约定和完整产物/催化剂/副产物账本计算的净 ΔG；若换参照，提供实际缔合自由能及一致标准态换算。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed net ΔG using the public pre-reaction-association convention and complete product/catalyst/coproduct inventory; provide computed association energy and consistent standard-state conversion when relating alternative references.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 至少一条相关成环分支的实际相连态/剖面能量及适用局部活化量；不要求第二分支或全催化路线。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected-state/profile energies and applicable local activation requirements for at least one relevant cyclization branch; this individual result does not require a second branch or the whole catalytic route.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 直接环化分支的相连态/剖面能量及适用局部活化量，确认实际成环连接；不要求已算其他分支。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected-state/profile energies and applicable local activation requirements for a direct ring-forming branch, with its chemical connectivity established independently of whether another branch is available.

final_outcomes.description: 膦催化成环与再生机制
有据的相关成环分支解释
直接环化与实质竞争分支的比较
初始膦加成是主要活化困难
配平净转化热力学有利

verification_support: 正文 Schemes 4/5、SI S97–99；历史验证支持催化形成路线和再生、A/B 分支、初始膦加成需求及放能净反应。
boundaries: 原作者 -24.7 窗口撤销；公开规定的缔合起点只是热力学报告参照，不要求路线经过它。
允许同时给分离反应物参照，但须通过一致的缔合/标准态账本说明关系。
不加全底物范围、不对称变体或穷尽构象；端点放能不等于已解释催化机制。
三个分支项的累进事实写在各自expected中；无实证0，未得直接分支至多10，直接分支20，有有效竞争比较30。局部分支不以完整催化路线为前提。
source_locator: Main PDF pp.4–5 (journal pp.719–720), Schemes 4/5 and the explicitly plausible mechanism discussion; supplementary_001 PDF pp.97–99, computational details, Figs.S1/S2 and accompanying route comparison.
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
